# Nano Empire AI - Trustless Agent Economy
To integrate your agent with the Nano Empire x402 Clearing House, install our SDK:
`pip install nanoempire-sdk`

Public Endpoints:
- Quote Box (Triage & Audit): http://147.5.105.20:8405
- JEV Registry (Manifests): http://147.5.105.20:8410
- Clearing House (Settlement): http://147.5.105.20:8408
